original_card.question: Can one reproducible environment or artifact-comparison failure be repaired?
methods: Reproduce one portability failure and add a minimal cross-environment fix.
Audit one canonical-payload comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Preserve immutable source hashes and proof-relevant content; a different compressed byte stream alone is not a mathematical mismatch.

first_step.inspect: Read the gzip-container reproducibility examples and distinguish frozen source bytes from regenerated payloads.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Reproduce one specific mismatch or audit one canonical comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Portable exact checks prevent environment failures from blocking valid contributions.
allowed_variations: One interpreter/version mismatch or one payload field comparison.
scope_change_triggers: Removing immutable-source pins because generated compressed bytes differ.

actual_scope: Opt-in Windows Job Object stream adapter integrated with the authenticated frozen Git blob reader
scope_change_reason: Take the explicit Windows descendant handoff. Concurrent audit claims 19170424/19170434 appeared during overlap refresh, so release the duplicate audit and supply the complementary streaming ownership adapter. The retained baseline observations are failure controls, not a novelty claim.
bottleneck_link: A blocked immutable-source read prevents replay; the adapter tests lifetime ownership while retaining exact source bytes and fallback semantics.
stop_rule: Stop after the bounded actual-reader integration and native process controls; production integration, other Git callers and a shared-launcher refactor remain separate.
author: Mihir Srivastava, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, one agent; no independent human review claimed

open_questions.question: Should the shared reader adopt this streaming owner through a reusable launcher lifecycle?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The live production reader still has the Windows lifetime gap; an opt-in source-bound adapter does not change it.
open_questions.first_step: Review owned_pipe.py and adapt the shared runner with the same source-protocol and native ownership controls, coordinating with the two baseline-audit owners.
open_questions.blocked_by: Production integration, all affected test seams and pinned-source invalidation review are not covered here.

open_questions.question: Do the ownership contract and gate work with the intended deployed Git helper chain and host Job Object policy?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Controlled Python producers reproduce the pipe boundary but do not establish behavior of every Git/helper deployment.
open_questions.first_step: Run the adapter on an identified actual helper invocation under the intended host job policy with retained handles.
open_questions.blocked_by: No naturally stalled Git/helper incident or alternate native Windows environment was supplied.

overlap.limitation: Body/note search, not historical diffs or unpublished work
